definitions.explanation: Small dry sweets with little moisture, such as pressed-sugar rakugan and sugar candies. Served with thin tea ({薄茶|うすちゃ}) in the tea ceremony, and contrasted with moist {生菓子|なまがし}.

examples.japanese: {干菓子|ひがし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
⟦{薄茶|うすちゃ}→薄茶：32160_usucha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{干菓子|ひがし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Dry sweets are served with thin tea.

examples.japanese: {落雁|らくがん}⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{干菓子|ひがし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日持|ひも}ち→日持ち：12886_himochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: Dry sweets such as rakugan keep well, so they make good souvenirs.

notes:
TYPES:
- {落雁|らくがん}: pressed sweets of rice flour and sugar
- {和三盆|わさんぼん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{干菓子|ひがし}: pressed sweets of fine wasanbon sugar
- ⟦{金平糖|こんぺいとう}→金平糖：14498_konpeitou⟧: small star-shaped sugar candies

SIMILAR WORDS:
